metadata.description: Default community plugin registry seed. Entries here are discoverable by default but remain restricted until the user installs and trusts them.

plugins.name: community/registry-starter
plugins.title: Community Registry Starter
plugins.description: A minimal community plugin that exercises the default registry source and install provenance path.

plugins.name: community/import-smoke-test
plugins.title: Community Import Smoke Test
plugins.description: A portable community plugin used to verify folder, zip, GitHub subpath, and marketplace import flows.

plugins.name: community/hallmark
plugins.title: Hallmark
plugins.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots.

plugins.name: community/humanize-ppt
plugins.title: Humanize PPT
plugins.description: Presentation system for agent-made PPTs: AST (audience-state-transfer) outline with per-page media decisions, a production brief for downstream renderers, and a capped 3-round presentation checkup on the rendered deck.

plugins.name: community/handoff-od
plugins.title: Handoff to OpenCode
plugins.description: Hand an Open Design project off to OpenCode as an offline-complete bundle: a verbatim project mirror, the design system materialized with real font binaries, and a machine-enforced adherence config.

plugins.name: community/proto-handoff
plugins.title: Export to Figma (proto-handoff)
plugins.description: Rebuild an accepted prototype in Figma as an editable design file: variables with light and dark modes, components with variants and slots, screens made of instances, prototype links, a flow map and a self-audit. Later changes update only what changed.

plugins.name: community/proto-handoff-prototype
plugins.title: Handoff-ready prototype
plugins.description: Single-file HTML app and web prototypes that declare their tokens, components, screens, states and navigation, so proto-handoff can rebuild them as an editable design file for Figma.
